scope: Selected directly relevant primary evidence discovered from supplied paper, Google Research/Search Central, author/publisher repositories and Google-assignee patent families. Not an exhaustive worldwide literature or patent/legal search. Research proposals and benchmark gains are not verified live Google ranking factors.

sources.title: Scalable Detection of Adversarial Synthetic Slop and Coordinated Media Abuse
sources.apply: Inspect repetitive low-value templates, provenance and claim quality; preserve legitimate creative AI use.
sources.limit: Video-platform coordinated account abuse; not evidence of a website AI-writing penalty or deployed Search classifier.

sources.title: Google Research S-CTS publication record
sources.apply: Verify attribution and publication context against supplied PDF.
sources.limit: Abstract reports evaluation details different from supplied PDF; do not combine numbers across versions.

sources.title: The Synthetic Gap: SAFE
sources.apply: Separate content, behavior and relatedness evidence; route uncertain findings to review.
sources.limit: Synthetic-media channel forensics, not a Search ranking formula.

sources.title: Can AI-Generated Text be Reliably Detected?
sources.apply: Reject detector-score-based declarations of AI authorship or content quality.
sources.limit: Detection attacks and theoretical limits; does not imply every detector always fails.

sources.title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers
sources.apply: Review English and Hebrew for usefulness/factual support rather than policing predictable prose.
sources.limit: Specific tested English detector populations; not a Hebrew-specific validation.

sources.title: GEO: Generative Engine Optimization
sources.apply: Use genuinely supported sources, clear passages and appropriate quantitative evidence; measure citations separately from mentions.
sources.limit: Benchmark and engine dependent; reported maximum uplift is not a forecast for this site or current engines.

sources.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
sources.apply: Check whether linked sources support specific adjacent claims; citation presence is insufficient.
sources.limit: Generation benchmark, not an SEO experiment.

sources.title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
sources.apply: Split claim bundles into verifiable role, contribution, numerical result, period and causal assertion.
sources.limit: We use a manual claim ledger inspired by atomic checking; do not label our checks an actual FActScore run.

sources.title: Detecting near-duplicates for web crawling
sources.apply: Compare main content across same-language pages and adjudicate genuine overlap.
sources.limit: Our transparent shingle scanner is not Google's SimHash implementation or a known production threshold.

sources.title: Spam policies for Google web search
sources.apply: Check scaled low-value pages, doorway patterns, keyword stuffing, scraped claims and misleading functionality.
sources.limit: Audit findings require actual page evidence; page count, shared templates or AI assistance alone do not establish abuse.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.apply: Review originality, substantive value, firsthand contribution, authorship and satisfying task completion.
sources.limit: Self-assessment questions, not a published weighted scoring model.

sources.title: Google Search's guidance on using generative AI content
sources.apply: Evaluate accuracy, relevance and additional value; avoid generating many pages without user value.
sources.limit: AI generation is not categorically prohibited.

sources.title: Google's guide to optimizing for generative AI features
sources.apply: Prefer unique useful existing pages and genuine source-specific assets over fan-out keyword variants.
sources.limit: No special AI file/schema guarantees inclusion; preserve useful existing discovery files without calling them a ranking lever.

sources.title: AI features and your website
sources.apply: Ensure crawl/index/snippet eligibility, visible text and truthful matching markup.
sources.limit: Eligibility does not guarantee indexing or AI inclusion.

sources.title: Contextual estimation of link information gain
sources.apply: Ask what the page adds beyond related pages; preserve genuinely distinct buyer decisions.
sources.limit: Patent-family proposal; not proof of deployed ranking weights. Avoid pretending our similarity metric measures patented information gain.

sources.title: Phrase-based detection of duplicate documents in an information retrieval system
sources.apply: Inspect same-language near-duplicate intent and repeated prose across the corpus.
sources.limit: Patent mechanism, not a current penalty specification; translations/shared legal text need separate treatment.

sources.title: Site quality score
sources.apply: Make brand identity and genuine user preference clear; support useful branded discovery.
sources.limit: No manufactured brand searches or clicks; patent does not establish actual live algorithm or a reproducible site quality score.

sources.title: Generative summaries for search results
sources.apply: Improve self-contained claim/source passages and accurate entity attribution for readers and retrieval.
sources.limit: Citation/summary mechanisms are proposed; not evidence of required schema, exact extraction windows or guaranteed inclusion.

sources.title: Massive rule-based classification engine
sources.apply: None: retained as an excluded search result.
sources.limit: Verified original assignee Wal Mart Stores Inc. Hosted on Google Patents does not mean Google owns it.

sources.title: Predicting site quality
sources.apply: Inspect repeated generic phrases and substantively distinguish the site's pages.
sources.limit: Historical phrase-frequency modeling proposal; no published forbidden word list, modern AI detector or confirmed current Search threshold.

sources.title: Identifying gibberish content in resources
sources.apply: Check incoherent text, generated artifacts and meaningless keyword stuffing.
sources.limit: Historical gibberish-detection patent; not evidence that polished AI-assisted writing is spam. Patent status is not a deployment status.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.apply: Put useful answers and necessary evidence together; remove buried or contradictory claim context.
sources.limit: Tested model/task/position effects; not proof of a current engine's retrieval window or an ideal page length.

sources.title: Knowledge-Based Trust: Estimating the Trustworthiness of Web Sources
sources.apply: Check factual support separately from popularity and link counts; distinguish extraction error from source error.
sources.limit: Research evaluation, not evidence this metric is deployed in current Google Search.

sources.title: Measuring Attribution in Natural Language Generation Models
sources.apply: Make subject, claim and supporting source interpretable together; source presence alone does not establish attribution.
sources.limit: Human annotation framework; no website rank or citation probability guarantee.

sources.title: Attributed Question Answering: Evaluation and Modeling for Attributed Large Language Models
sources.apply: Evaluate answer correctness and supporting-source attribution separately.
sources.limit: Benchmark/model evaluation, not a deployed SEO recipe.
